summary: Independent review reproduced both reported defects on the prepared base: Anthropic output_config.effort=xhigh was rewritten to max, and a chat-template validation ValueError returned a generic HTTP 500 for streaming and non-streaming requests. At the exact candidate commit, xhigh is preserved and the validation failure returns HTTP 400 invalid_request_error with the accepted-set message in both modes. Independent adversarial TypeError and RuntimeError conversion failures remain HTTP 500, showing the new classification is limited to ValueError. The complete Anthropic serving unit suite passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: xhigh mapped to max; template-style ValueError produced generic HTTP 500 for stream=false and stream=true. TypeError and RuntimeError also produced 500. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-aea691ddf9de/base-probe.txt.

Passing-after and adversarial evidence: xhigh mapped to xhigh; template-style ValueError returned descriptive HTTP 400 in both modes; unrelated TypeError and RuntimeError remained generic HTTP 500. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-aea691ddf9de/candidate-probe.txt.
Candidate regression tests: 2 passed, 60 deselected, and 7 effort-mapping subtests passed.
Complete Anthropic serving unit suite: 62 passed and 7 subtests passed.
Candidate patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: No model inference was run. The assigned device was detected as one AMD Instinct MI355X under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 (HIP 7.2.26015), whereas the source report used an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell/CUDA 13.0.3 and RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4. The verified behavior occurs before generation in Python request conversion/error classification.

remaining_limitations: No live RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 endpoint was available, so end-to-end model generation on the reporter's NVIDIA SM120 architecture was not repeated. The prepared checkout imported sglang, anthropic.serving, and anthropic.protocol from /job/repo/python. No C++, FlyDSL, LLVM, or other native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable. The review validates the original pre-generation contract with the actual checked-out implementation and independent stream/non-stream/adversarial probes, but makes no GPU numerical-output claim.
